name: VoxelBlockyModelMesh
definition: A method to generate a voxel model based on a custom mesh rather than requiring cubes, allowing versatile model creation using standard 3D editor meshes with UV-mapping.
summary: VoxelBlockyModelMesh generates voxel models from arbitrary 3D meshes using per-voxel side culling and cutouts, differing from other methods by handling non-cubic geometry.
